svg.title: Sixteen columns, one color, six compares
svg.desc: A sixteen by six block of colors 5, 2 and 7. Six vector compares with color 2, weighted by row and ORed, give the sixteen column values 0, 0, 3, 15, 63, 63, 60, 48, 0, 0, 0, 0, 3, 15, 63, 63.
svg.text: Sixteen columns, one color, six compares
Which pixels of this 16 × 6 block are color 2?
OR of the weighted matches, per lane:
One 16-byte store puts all sixteen values into the map at once.
